freeze_rule: Metric tiers and applicability are frozen before request materialization and cannot be changed after observing B0/B1 results.

REQUIRED.definition: Required in the third-party delivery whenever applicable to the dataset.

ADDITIONAL.definition: Optional diagnostic or alternative accounting metric.

applicability.accuracy_or_official_task_score: REQUIRED only when the dataset has a frozen oracle or official scorer; otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE.
applicability.oom_count: REQUIRED for every run; report zero when no OOM occurs.
applicability.silent_truncation_rate: REQUIRED for long-context and explicit-length tests; otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE.
applicability.declared_cross_scenario_geometric_mean: REQUIRED once for the predeclared acceptance scenario set, not once per dataset.
applicability.pricing: REQUIRED for the designated pricing configuration; private unit-cost and margin values may be delivered in a restricted annex.
applicability.tpot_ms_per_token: NOT_APPLICABLE to successful responses with fewer than two output tokens.
